description_zh: 调用DescribeLogMonitorList接口获取日志监控列表
name: DescribeLogMonitorList

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示记录条数。默认：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to search for log monitoring metrics. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 监控项搜索。支持模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

Code.description_en:
The status code.

The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

GmtCreate.description_en:
The time when the log monitoring metric was created.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
GmtCreate.description_zh:
创建时间。

格式为Unix时间戳，即从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the application group

LogId.description_en: The ID of the log monitoring metric

MetricName.description_en: The metric name. For more information, see [Appendix 1: Metrics]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html）
MetricName.description_zh: 监控项名称。详情请参见[云产品监控项]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html）

SlsLogstore.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) Logstore

SlsProject.description_en: The name of the SLS project

SlsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the SLS Logstore resides

ValueFilter.description_en: The condition that is used to filter logs. The ValueFilter and ValueFilterRelation parameters are used in pair. The filter condition is equivalent to the WHERE clause in SQL statements. If no filter condition is specified, all logs are processed. For example, logs contain the Level and Error fields. If you need to calculate the number of times that logs of the Error level appear every minute, you can set the filter condition to Level=Error and count the number of logs that meet this condition
ValueFilter.description_zh:
筛选的过滤规则，配合ValueFilterRelation使用。相当于SQL中的Where条件。
如果不填写，则表示对全部数据进行处理。例如：日志中有Level和Error字段，如果需要统计每分钟Error出现的次数，则统计方法可以定义为对Level求和，并且Level=Error

Key.description_en: The name of the log field used for matching in the filter condition

Operator.description_en:
The method that is used to match the field value. Valid values:

contain: contains

notContain: does not contain

`>`: greater than

`<`: less than

`>=`: greater than or equal to

`<=`: less than or equal to
Operator.description_zh:
字段值的匹配方式。取值：
contain：包含。
notContain：不包含。
`>`：大于。
`<`：小于。
`>=`：大于等于。
`<=`：小于等于

Value.description_en: The field value to be matched in the filter condition

ValueFilterRelation.description_en:
The logical operator that is used between log filter conditions. The ValueFilter and ValueFilterRelation parameters are used in pair. Valid values:

and

or
ValueFilterRelation.description_zh:
日志筛选的过滤条件。需要和ValueFilter配合使用。取值：
and：表示和的关系。
or ：表示或的关系

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
